title: MedxR: Access Drug Regulatory Data via FDA and Health Canada APIs
text: MedxR package provides unified interface access open drug regulatory data U.S. Food Drug Administration (FDA) Open API Health Canada Drug Product Database API. allows users retrieve real-time historical information drug approvals, adverse events, product recalls, pharmaceutical details, enabling transparent reproducible analysis regulatory information across North America. addition API-access functions, package includes curated collection open datasets related drugs, pharmaceuticals, treatments, clinical studies. datasets encompass diverse topics , treatment dosages, pharmacological research, placebo effects, drug reactions, misuse pain relievers, vaccine effectiveness. MedxR designed support researchers, educators, healthcare professionals integrating international RESTful APIs structured datasets public, academic, government sources single, easy--use R package. provides comprehensive foundation pharmacological research, regulatory analysis, health data science.

title: MedxR: Access Drug Regulatory Data via FDA and Health Canada APIs
text: MedxR package provides several core functions access real-time structured information drugs pharmaceutical products public APIs FDA Open API Health Canada Drug Product Database API. functions allow users query, retrieve, analyze regulatory data related drug approvals, adverse events, product recalls, drug shortages, ensuring reproducible transparent access official medical regulatory information. list main functions included package: get_fda_adverse_events(): Search Adverse Events Drug Name FDA Adverse Event Reporting System, e.g., get_fda_adverse_events("aspirin"). get_fda_drug_labels(): Search Drug Labels Drug Name FDA Drug Labeling Database, e.g., get_fda_drug_labels("aspirin"). get_fda_drugs_approved(): Search FDA-Approved Drugs Drug Name, e.g., get_fda_drugs_approved("lipitor"). get_fda_ndc_directory(): Search National Drug Code (NDC) Directory Drug Name, e.g., get_fda_ndc_directory("ibuprofen"). get_hc_active_ingredients(): Get Active Ingredients Health Canada Drug Product Database. get_hc_companies(): Get Companies Health Canada Drug Product Database. get_hc_din(): Get DINs Health Canada Drug Product Database. get_hc_drug_by_din(): Get Drug Product DIN Health Canada Drug Product Database, e.g., get_hc_drug_by_din("00000213"). get_hc_drug_products(): Retrieve Drug Products Health Canada Drug Product Database. get_hc_forms(): Get Pharmaceutical Forms Health Canada Drug Product Database. get_hc_search_drug(): Search Drug Products Brand Name Health Canada Drug Product Database, e.g., get_hc_search_drug("NEMBUTAL"). functions allow users access high-quality structured information drugs regulatory data, can seamlessly combined tools like dplyr ggplot2 support wide range data analysis, visualization, pharmacological research tasks. following sections, ’ll find examples work MedxR practical scenarios, including retrieving data FDA Health Canada APIs, well exploring analyzing curated datasets included package.

what: Top 10 Canadian Companies by Number of Registered Drug Products
title: MedxR: Access Drug Regulatory Data via FDA and Health Canada APIs
code: # Retrieve data from Health Canada APIs drug_products <- get_hc_drug_products() companies <- get_hc_companies()  # Combine both datasets by company name merged_data <- drug_products %>%   left_join(companies, by = "company_name") %>%   filter(!is.na(company_name)) %>%   group_by(company_name) %>%   summarise(total_products = n()) %>%   arrange(desc(total_products)) %>%   slice_head(n = 10)  # Plot: Top 10 companies by number of registered drug products ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = reorder(company_name, total_products), y = total_products)) +   geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +   coord_flip() +   labs(     title = "Top 10 Canadian Companies by Number of Registered Drug Products",     x = "Company Name",     y = "Number of Drug Products",     caption = "Source: Health Canada Drug Product Database (via MedxR)"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
